thread:
Samira Khan: FYI — HealTrack pilot goes live 07:30 PT. pilot flagged high churn risk; CS wants a one-page runbook for tenant-prefill + streaming fallback + renewal signals.
Joey Kim: noted. traffic forecast?
Samira Khan: baseline 40 qps, first-hour bursts up to 220 qps. PHI rules: tenant-only caches, KMS logging.
Ravi Patel: quick runbook draft: 1) prefill top-30 prefixes 3m before go-live, TTL 4m sliding refresh; 2) warm pool 3 GPUs for first 90m; 3) batching window 6ms, auto-disable if p95 >120ms; 4) streaming fallback when prefill miss latency >180ms.
Elena Ruiz: add CS-facing checklist: tokens provisioned, KMS key verified, prefill dry-run results >=60% hit for top prefixes, set renewal-watch flag if hit_pct <40 after 45m.
Samira Khan: how to avoid cost spike?
Ravi Patel: staged ramp (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 25m) + temporary quota cap for tenant to limit bill shock.
Joey Kim: ops snippets for customer doc:
```
curl -X POST https://console.api.redwood/prefill \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"tenant":"healtrack","prefixes":["patient:","visit:","lab:"]}'
```
Ravi Patel: dry-run endpoint: POST /admin/prefill/dryrun {"tenant":"healtrack","sample_size":150} -> returns expected hit distribution; prefill tags: {"export":false,"kms":"redwood-kms-02"}.
Elena Ruiz: telemetry to #cs-telemetry: p99_ms, prefill_hit_pct, warm_pods. set auto-alert if p99 >200ms for 10m or hit_pct drops >20% vs dry-run.
ops-bot: prefills queued (job-id: pf-1799998080)
Samira Khan: fallback plan for OOMs: switch to q4_small variant, set batch-size=1, enable streaming-only, create incident. notify CS and Sales.
Joey Kim: i'll package this into a one-pager customer-facing runbook (non-technical) + an ops checklist (technical) and share with CS and the customer. review cycle by 18:00 PT.
Ravi Patel: added enforcement for tenant-only & KMS tags, pushed prefill job.
ops-bot: job pf-1799998080 completed: prefill_hit_estimate=67%
Elena Ruiz: looks good. Samira, ping me if customer wants larger prefix list after first hour.
Samira Khan: thanks team — I'll send runbook and schedule 15m post-launch check-in. :rocket:
